reviews.text: I just completed the 6 week challenge at F45 KOP and the results were amazing. I lost 11 lbs and 6% body fat. I didnt have high expectations at first, but it only took one class to get me to be a believer. The staff is incredibly welcoming and make you feel like family right away. The workouts are constantly changing so each day is a new challenge. I found myself excited to wake up early to get to morning classes before work. It truly was a life changing experience and I cant wait to keep training at F45!! Huge thank you to the staff for being so supportive!
reviews.author: Danny Rosenbaum

reviews.text:
A+. All around A+. I signed up as a part of the 6-week challenge initially and am now a member of the studio. The workouts are great. The staff is great. The location and studio are great.

I almost never give reviews but I was so compelled to write this because of my amazing experience with F45 King of Prussia. It really doesn't matter where you are in your fitness journey - F45 is for you. Literally anyone and everyone should do this. It really is life changing. I can almost guarantee it.
reviews.author: Dan Dingman

reviews.text:
Great group workout studio, with a phenomenal staff. They treat you like family at F45 Training King of Prussia. The studio is large and clean - you can tell ownership takes pride in what they have to offer.

I signed up for F45 Training King of Prussia's 6 Week Challenge. I was looking for something that I could commit to that would help get me back into shape. F45 Training KOP was by far the right answer for me.

The first few classes, I was just trying to survive. The workouts are challenging, but each day is different - so they do not become monotonous. As time went on, I could not only see the progress, I could also feel it. I was losing weight and gaining strength. I went from trying to survive, to challenging myself to be better on each and every rep.

My results speak for themselves. I lost 29 lbs and about 7% body fat. Not bad for 6 weeks of work!

I continue to enjoy working out at F45 Training KOP, and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a good workout.
reviews.author: Joe DeGiorgi

reviews.text:
If you want a gym a fantastic gym with amazing trainers that actually care about you. Look no further and go join TODAY!

I joined F45 with my fiancé a few weeks ago to help jump start our wedding weightless. We had a membership to another gym in the area that we're paying for but not going to for lack of motivation and struggled to find something we both enjoyed. Since F45 is a mix of both cardio and weight classes, we decided to try something new and started the 6-week challenge.

After just 7 short weeks, I am happy to say that this place has changed my life for the better. When I joined, my first class was on Saturday which I found out was an hour long instead of the typical 45 minute week day classes. Pretty embarrassed to say that I couldn't even make it through the entire workout because of how out of shape I was and in that moment didn't think I would be coming back. Fortunately, there is amazing team that pushed me to keep going and didn't let me get discouraged.  I am happy to say that after today's workout, I am down 11.2 pounds and 5.7% body fat. Although working out is a routine, the classes are never the same which makes working out actually FUN (yes, I said it). To be quite honest, I never saw myself having a daily workout routine, but with F45 I cannot imagine going back to being a couch potato.

Shout out to the owners Matt & Amanda for running an awesome place that makes newbies feel welcome. You guys are killing it!
reviews.author: Sara Brasch

reviews.text: These workouts are incredible! The interval routines are different everyday and every coach is super motivating the entire class. Very personalized experience
